subject: Class of 2021 Senior Year Planning
overview: Administrators and student officers met to address concerns regarding the senior year experience during the pandemic. The forum covered health and safety protocols, academic requirements, and the planning of socially distanced social events.

items.title: Introductions and Forum Overview
items.summary: Administrators and student class officers introduced themselves and outlined the forum's purpose to address senior-specific events and concerns.

items.title: Senior Events and Fall Activities
items.summary: The class advisors and officers announced plans for socially distanced events including a 'Senior Sunrise' on November 21st and a drive-in movie on November 25th.

items.title: NHS Induction and Winter Event Planning
items.summary: Administrators discussed hosting the National Honor Society induction in compliance with health guidelines and being creative with outdoor winter events.

items.title: Service Hour Requirements
items.summary: Officials stated they will offer flexibility and accommodation regarding the 60-hour community service graduation requirement rather than waiving it entirely.

items.title: Clubs and Activities Master List
items.summary: The administration is compiling a master list of active clubs and their meeting formats to be published to the school community.

items.title: HVAC Repairs and Return to School
items.summary: Contractors are currently repairing the high school's HVAC systems to ensure proper air exchange before students can return to in-person learning.

items.title: Vocational Shop Reopening and Requirements
items.summary: Vocational shops will be phased in as air exchange reports are finalized, and state-mandated competency hours have been modified for the current year.

items.title: SAT Testing and College Guidance
items.summary: Administrators reviewed the success of a recent in-person SAT session and are seeking permission from the College Board to host future Medford-only testing dates.

items.title: Academic Workload and Screen Time
items.summary: The administration acknowledged concerns regarding high levels of homework and screen time, noting that curriculum directors are reviewing pacing guides.

items.title: Community Support and Recognition
items.summary: The forum confirmed the continuation of recognition programs such as 'Adopt a Senior' and senior banners to celebrate the class of 2021.

items.title: Remote Learning Student Perspectives
items.summary: Student officers shared the challenges of virtual learning, specifically the loss of hands-on labs and extracurricular activities like drama and music.

items.title: Athletics and College Visits
items.summary: Officials discussed the difficulty of safe sporting events, the policy allowing three excused absences for college visits, and the opening of winter sports registration.

items.title: Yearbook and School Communications
items.summary: The yearbook staff is collecting photos and designing pages, while the administration is working on improving communication through an updated parent contact form.

items.title: Graduation Ceremony Commitment
items.summary: Administrators pledged to exhaust every possibility to hold an in-person graduation ceremony rather than a virtual one, pending Board of Health approval.

items.title: COVID-19 Safety and School Calendar
items.summary: Officials addressed school building safety measures and confirmed that the district will honor all breaks currently listed in the school calendar.
